name: CloudStride Runner (Women)
description: Everyday running sneaker with a dual-density foam midsole for all-day cushioning.
care_instructions: Spot clean with mild soap and water. Remove insoles and air dry. Do not machine wash or tumble dry.
fit_note_detail: Runs about half a size small. If you are between sizes, size up.

name: CloudStride Runner (Men)
description: Everyday running sneaker with a dual-density foam midsole for all-day cushioning.
care_instructions: Spot clean with mild soap and water. Remove insoles and air dry. Do not machine wash or tumble dry.
fit_note_detail: Runs about half a size small. If you are between sizes, size up.

name: Breeze Knit Slip-On
description: Lightweight slip-on with a stretch knit upper and a soft memory-foam footbed.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle in a laundry bag. Air dry only.
fit_note_detail: True to size. The knit stretches slightly with wear.

name: Harbour Loafer
description: Full-grain leather penny loafer with a cushioned leather-lined footbed.
care_instructions: Wipe with a damp cloth. Condition the leather every few months. Keep away from direct heat.
fit_note_detail: Runs slightly large. Consider going half a size down.

name: Aria Ballet Flat
description: Soft leather ballet flat with a padded heel and flexible sole.
care_instructions: Wipe with a soft dry cloth. Use leather protector spray before first wear.
fit_note_detail: True to size. Available in narrow for slimmer feet.

name: Trailmate Hiker
description: Waterproof mid-height hiking boot with a grippy lugged outsole. Sized in men's US sizes.
care_instructions: Brush off dirt after use. Rinse with clean water and air dry away from heat. Re-proof the suede seasonally.
fit_note_detail: True to size in men's US sizing. Women should go down 1.5 sizes from their women's US size.

name: Sol Sandal
description: Two-strap sandal with a contoured cork footbed. Clearance item.
care_instructions: Wipe straps with a damp cloth. Avoid soaking the cork footbed.

name: Nimbus Recovery Slide
description: Thick cushioned foam slide for post-workout and at-home recovery. Sized in men's US sizes.
care_instructions: Rinse with water. Safe to hand wash. Air dry.
fit_note_detail: Runs large. Half sizes should size down to the nearest whole size.

name: Metro Oxford
description: Classic leather oxford with a hidden cushioned insole for office comfort.
care_instructions: Polish regularly. Use shoe trees to keep shape. Wipe with a damp cloth.

name: Summit Chelsea Boot
description: Leather Chelsea boot with elastic side panels and a cushioned footbed.
care_instructions: Wipe with a damp cloth. Condition the leather regularly. Water resistant, not waterproof.
fit_note_detail: Runs small. Size up half a size, or a full size if wearing thick socks.

name: Pace Walker
description: Supportive walking shoe with a firm heel counter and arch support for long days on your feet.
care_instructions: Spot clean with mild soap and water. Air dry away from direct heat.
fit_note_detail: True to size. Wide fit has a roomier toe box.

name: Coast Espadrille
description: Canvas espadrille with a jute-wrapped sole. Clearance item.
care_instructions: Spot clean only. Keep the jute sole dry.
fit_note_detail: Runs large. Size down half a size.
